verification_limits: The reviewer read the actual runner and completed reports and recomputed hashes/comparisons; the reviewer did not launch Worker, HTTP, a model or a build.
These are real Worker HTTP with disposable D1/R2 and real TXT/rules service, with explicitly injected synthetic fact output. They are not real-model or business/legal acceptance.
The old-build receipt records hashes after the old HTTP run and prior successful ROUND18 build provenance; it is not a fresh 02cf rebuild and does not establish a before/after dist-byte comparison.
The nine failing old cases stop at their failing preliminary assertions, so their later forced-historical-read and restart inclusion did not execute in the old-red run.
Final restart checks persistent state, history, job/material raw and absence of confirmation/calculation for 130 snapshots; it does not reassert every derived amount after restart.
The HTTP cases cover the stated finite 13 examples, not every duration, traditional spelling or arbitrary natural-language rate form.
